Done. Here's the exception page at a glance:

| # | ID | Var USD |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `Engineering_Software_202602` | +16,417.60 |
| 2 | `Sales_Travel_202602` | +8,842.30 |
| 3 | `Marketing_Training_202602` | +6,342.80 |
| 4 | `Operations_Equipment_202601` | +6,912.70 |

**Four flagged items, $38,515.40 total unfavourable.**

Why so short:
- **Facilities** — the only front-loaded category — is tested cumulatively against the full-year budget. Every department's cumulative spend is still well under its annual allocation, so zero Facilities flags despite the January spike everyone argued about last cycle. That's exactly what the policy is designed to do.
- Eight items that would have flagged on percentage alone were excluded by the $5,000 dollar limb (e.g. Marketing Equipment Feb at +$4,318 / 48%, HR Training Jan at +$3,105 / 52%). Another two that cleared the dollar limb failed the 10% threshold on large bases (e.g. Engineering Salaries Feb at +$8,903 / 1.4%).
